studies.headline: Fixture: a field experiment on free-shipping thresholds
studies.the_study: A field experiment with an online retailer randomly assigned 48,200 customers to one of three free-shipping thresholds over eight weeks.
studies.why_it_matters: Threshold design changes basket size more than the discount itself.
studies.story_angle_primary: Test the threshold before the discount.
studies.story_angle_secondary: Why you add one more thing to the cart.

studies.headline: Fixture: a survey of loyalty-program members
studies.the_study: A survey of 412 respondents analyzed with structural equation modeling.
studies.why_it_matters: Members say points feel like money.
studies.story_angle_secondary: No real angle for general readers.
studies.caveats: Cross-sectional survey; stated intentions rather than behavior.
